name: groupchat-analytics-engine
description: Group-chat analytics engine in TypeScript + PostgreSQL: Instagram export ingestion, identity reconciliation, multi-provider LLM sentiment, daily member scoring, and a Netflix-themed Next.js site. Live demo runs on a synthetic chat.

paragraphs: A data pipeline and analytics site for group-chat exports, presented as a streaming service. Members are "shows", messages are "episodes", and a nightly pipeline turns a raw Instagram export into daily member scores, a stock-market-style chart, Netflix-style category rows and a Spotify-Wrapped-style recap for each person.
Live demo: groupchat-wrapped-demo.vercel.app. It's a fully fictional chat, generated by this repo and analyzed by the same pipeline.

The original runs privately on a real friend group's chat: about 1M messages, 0.9M reactions and 860 senders over about six and a half months. Every name and message in this repo, its screenshots and the demo comes from a synthetic chat (below). The only facts from the real chat are aggregate pipeline metrics (sizes, run times, counts), and no real conversation data is published.
